title: Viscose: a portfolio carousel where every card is a signed distance field in one fullscreen shader
description:
Viscose is a portfolio carousel where the whole ring is one fullscreen fragment shader, not a grid of DOM elements. Card positions arrive as uniforms and the shader blends their signed distance fields with a smooth minimum, so neighbours melt together as they close and string thinning threads as they part. Clicking a card centres it but opens nothing yet, and there's no reduced-motion path. #github #opensource 

https://github.com/Yousuf-developer/Viscose-carousel
